name: stock_opening_line
description: GH #3775 / REQ-725, decision 0079 section D2. One line of an opening balance document. header_id is the record_id of the stock_opening header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_stock_opening_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). line_no is the position 1..n. location_id and responsible_id are record ids of modules locations and org, catalog_item_id, catalog_uom_id and catalog_lot_id of module catalog_items (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict). received_on is the real receipt date of the stock, a field only: it never becomes the event time. unit_price and line_value are optional exact decimals kept on the document only (never posted to the ledger). external_ref_system and external_ref_id are an optional pair for the xlsx import. Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of a line changes.
